title: Merge Two Sorted Linked Lists
prompt:
You are given the heads of two singly linked lists (`Option<Box<ListNode>>`), each already sorted in non-decreasing order. Splice their nodes together into one sorted list and return its head. Either input may be `None` (empty).

Signature: `fn merge_sorted_lists(a: Option<Box<ListNode>>, b: Option<Box<ListNode>>) -> Option<Box<ListNode>>`

The starter provides `ListNode::from_vec` and `ListNode::to_vec` helpers.

Example:
  a: 1 -> 4 -> 6     b: 2 -> 4 -> 9
  result: 1 -> 2 -> 4 -> 4 -> 6 -> 9
